title: Spectral Quality Control
description: Mirrors data.quality_report's shape (analysis/data/quality.py) applied to spectra instead of tabular columns — see analysis/spectrometry/quality.py for the 15 checks. Never auto-deletes a flagged spectrum; quality.set_status is the only way to change a spectrum's status, and it's always a logged manual override.

response.checks: {check_name: finding[]} for all 15 checks (check_empty_spectra, check_non_numeric_values, check_out_of_range_reflectance, check_saturation, check_low_reflectance, check_high_noise, check_missing_bands, check_duplicate_wavelengths, check_incomplete_spectra, check_detector_discontinuities, check_possible_calibration_issues, check_duplicate_files, check_duplicate_sample_ids, check_identical_spectra, check_insufficient_spectral_range)
